ownership_reason: Only the convergent loop sees the successive convergents; the 10,000 bound has to stop the expansion before a convergent with a larger denominator replaces the last admissible one. Once the loop has run past the bound that convergent is gone: no caller can recover 2/3 from the returned pair 33333/50000, and no caller-side rounding or narrowing of the value restores it, because the expansion of any rounded decimal still runs to that decimal's exact fraction. The sibling overload Fraction.getFraction(double) stops at the same bound in its own loop and documents it ('bounding the denominator by 10,000'); FractionTest.testFactory_double (passing) pins 0.66666 -> 2/3 and 1/10001 -> 0/1 through it, and compares it with getReducedFraction over all small denominators. Known bypass (W13, not a competing repair): hop 1 or hop 2 can call Fraction.getFraction(double) directly, which discards hops 2-5 or 3-5.
